notes: Starting(5): Hidden Base (dested the Objective Hidden Base / Systems Will Slip Through Your Fingers), Rendezvous Point, 'Corulag (Hidden Base)', The Signal (starting Interrupt) and Goo Nee Tay (starting Effect).
Corulag is listed twice, once under Starting and once under Locations ('Corulag (activation, -1 drain for opp.)'); both lines kept as posted, so the list has 2 copies of a unique system.
Every line carries the poster's comment in brackets (e.g. '(drain)', '(Extra Gen.)'); these are not part of the card names.

Posted 'CC Leia's Hut' dested Cloud City: Guest Quarters (Leia's room on Cloud City; no 'Leia's Hut' card exists); 'CC Carbo Chamber' Cloud City: Carbonite Chamber; 'Han With Gun' Han With Heavy Blaster Pistol; 'Chewie With Gun' Chewie With Blaster Rifle; 'KFC' Kal'Falnl C'ndros; 'Pucimer Thryss' Pucumir Thryss; 'Orrimarko' Orrimaarko; 'RLIR1' Red Leader In Red 1; 'GLIG1' Gold Leader In Gold 1; 'Lando In Falcon' Lando In Millennium Falcon.
